---
title: "pcaLab Reproducible PCA Analysis"
output: html_document
params:
  data: NULL
  group: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(pcaLab)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=TRUE,fig.width=7,fig.height=5)
X <- params$data
stopifnot(!is.null(X))
```

# Data audit

```{r}
doctor <- pca_doctor(X)
doctor
```

# Classical PCA

```{r}
fit <- pca_fit(X,method="classical",center=TRUE,scale=TRUE)
summary(fit)
```

# Dimensionality

```{r}
selection <- pca_ncomp(fit,methods="all",nperm=499,nboot=200,seed=2026)
selection$recommendations
pca_plot(fit,"dimension_selection",selection=selection)
```

# Inference and stability

```{r}
inference <- pca_test(fit,nperm=999,seed=2026)
bootstrap <- pca_boot(fit,nboot=999,seed=2026)
inference$global
inference$axes
```

# Variable interpretation

```{r}
assoc <- pca_associate(fit,test=inference,boot=bootstrap)
assoc
pca_plot(fit,"correlation_circle")
pca_plot(fit,"bootstrap_loadings",bootstrap=bootstrap,component=1)
```

# Scores

```{r}
if (is.null(params$group)) {
  pca_plot(fit,"scores")
} else {
  rg <- pca_group(fit,params$group,region="bootstrap",nboot=999,seed=2026)
  pca_plot(fit,"scores",group=params$group,group_region=rg)
}
```

# Diagnostics

```{r}
pca_diagnose(fit)
pca_plot(fit,"diagnostics")
```

# Reproducibility

```{r}
sessionInfo()
```
